name: EITA
recent: EITA 近期获得 RM221mil 电力项目合约，并有多项董事及大股东股权变动申报，包括集团董事经理在闭门期外的增持及闭门期内交易意向通知。
notable: 获得价值 RM221mil 的电力项目合约。
集团董事经理 Lim Joo Swee 在 10 月 8 日至 9 日于闭门期外增持公司股份。
董事及大股东提交多项股权变动申报，包括 Lim Joo Swee 与 Goh Kin Bee 的权益变动。
risks: 董事在闭门期内表明有意进行交易，可能涉及股权变动。
大股东 Goh Kin Bee 的权益变动申报，需留意后续持股变化。

recent_en: EITA recently secured a RM221mil power project contract and has multiple filings on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including the Group Managing Director's acquisitions outside closed period and intention to deal during closed period.
notable_en: Secured a power project contract worth RM221mil.
Group Managing Director Lim Joo Swee acquired shares outside closed period on 8-9 October.
Multiple filings on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including those of Lim Joo Swee and Goh Kin Bee.
risks_en: Director indicated intention to deal during closed period, which may involve changes in shareholding.
Substantial shareholder Goh Kin Bee's interest change filing warrants attention to subsequent shareholding changes.
